Track the price, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna Price Tracker

Track prices in one tap. Your phone will check the price for you every day. Get notified when the price drops. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna Price Tracker
  4. Select Allow on all websites

Your browsing history and data is kept entirely on device. Luna works on your phone to improve your browsing experience and let you retrieve your own history locally.
